title: Lakhpat Rai Tightens the Pursuit with Fire and Cannon

blocks.text: The Singhs initially strike the enemy's front ranks hard enough to show that courage has not left them. But after the first shock, Lakhpat Rai reorganizes the pursuit so that cannon in front and supporting fire from behind make repeated charges increasingly costly.

He then attacks the terrain itself. Pathways are cut through cover, thickets were burned, and the Khalsa is denied the forests and broken ground that had previously let smaller bands escape larger forces.

Under this pressure the Singhs are driven from refuge to refuge without rest. The running battle now becomes a campaign of attrition, with fire, artillery, and encirclement gradually pushing the exhausted fugitives toward the river routes ahead.
